items.ar: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا﴾
items.en: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins."

items.ar: ﴿وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدَىٰ﴾
items.en: "And indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance."
"Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds."
"Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear."

items.ar: «أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ»
items.en: "The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small."

items.ar: «مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَكَفَّارَتُهَا أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا»
items.en: "Whoever forgets a prayer or sleeps through it, its expiation is to pray it when he remembers it."
